#### Fns of `hub`

- `hub/explore_list`: What a folder holds, live from the system that serves it, a page at a time. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{uri: text, cursor?: text}) => obj{
    items: list<obj{
      uri: text,
      name: text,
      type: enum<text>{folder, file, page, record, other},
      mime?: text,
      format?: text,
      size?: num{whole=true, min=0},
      modifiedAt?: num{whole=true},
      version: text
    }>,
    cursor?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/explore_read`: One file's text (or its bytes by content ref) or its links, live, without keeping it in the hub. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    uri: text,
    want: list<enum<text>{links, text, bytes}>
  }) => obj{ stat, links?, text?, bytes? … }
  ```
- `hub/data_sets`: The stored types (the data system's record sets) you can see, each with how many records it holds and when one last changed. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    cursor?: text,
    limit?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=200},
    text?: text,
    system?: text
  }) => obj{
    items: list<obj{
      type: text,
      system: text,
      description: text,
      storage: obj{
        shape: enum<text>{table, value},
        owner: enum<text>{shared, person},
        search: obj{text: list<text{minLength=1}>, embed: bool}
      },
      records: num{whole=true, min=0},
      updatedAt?: num{whole=true}
    }>,
    cursor?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/records_find`: Records of one stored type: filtered and sorted on its fields, searched by words (and meaning, when the type is embedded), a page at a time. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ type, query?, search?, run? … }) => obj{
    items: list<obj{
      /* record id */ id: text,
      type: text,
      value: any,
      owner?: text,
      title: text,
      version: num{whole=true, min=1},
      createdAt: num{whole=true},
      updatedAt: num{whole=true},
      updatedBy?: text,
      updatedBySystem?: text,
      run?: text
    }>,
    cursor?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/record_get`: One record of a stored type by its id, with its value, version and who changed it last. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{type: text, /* record id */ id: text, run?: text}) => obj{
    record?: obj{
      /* record id */ id: text,
      type: text,
      value: any,
      owner?: text,
      title: text,
      version: num{whole=true, min=1},
      createdAt: num{whole=true},
      updatedAt: num{whole=true},
      updatedBy?: text,
      updatedBySystem?: text,
      run?: text
    }
  }
  ```
- `hub/records_table`: Records of one stored type as a table (one column per field, then the record id), offset-paged: what widgets and the result view draw. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ type, query?, search?, run?, offset?, limit? … }) => obj{ columns, rows, offset, limit?, total?, truncated, sort, write?, records? … }
  ```
- `hub/record_versions`: A record's history, newest first: each version's value, how it changed, and who changed it. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    cursor?: text,
    limit?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=200},
    type: text,
    /* record id */ id: text
  }) => obj{
    items: list<obj{
      id: text{minLength=1},
      /* record id */ record: text,
      type: text,
      number: num{whole=true, min=1},
      change: enum<text>{created, updated, removed},
      value: any,
      by?: text,
      bySystem?: text,
      run?: text,
      at: num{whole=true}
    }>,
    cursor?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/record_save`: Add a record to a stored type, or replace one (with its id); the value is checked against the type.

  ```text
  (obj{type: text, id?: text, value: any, expect?: num{whole=true, min=1}, run?: text}) => obj{
    /* record id */ id: text,
    type: text,
    value: any,
    owner?: text,
    title: text,
    version: num{whole=true, min=1},
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    updatedAt: num{whole=true},
    updatedBy?: text,
    updatedBySystem?: text,
    run?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/record_update`: Change some fields of one record in place, keeping the rest; the merged value is checked against the type.

  ```text
  (obj{
    type: text,
    /* record id */ id: text,
    set: any,
    expect?: num{whole=true, min=1},
    run?: text
  }) => obj{
    /* record id */ id: text,
    type: text,
    value: any,
    owner?: text,
    title: text,
    version: num{whole=true, min=1},
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    updatedAt: num{whole=true},
    updatedBy?: text,
    updatedBySystem?: text,
    run?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/record_remove`: Remove a record of a stored type; its history stays.

  ```text
  (obj{type: text, /* record id */ id: text, run?: text}) => obj{removed: bool}
  ```
- `hub/read_table`: Run a read fn that returns a table, as a child run of the caller, as its person, and give the table. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{fn: text, args: any}) => obj{ columns, rows, offset, limit?, total?, truncated, sort, write?, records? … }
  ```
- `hub/visuals`: Every visual of the hub's visual registry (hub/visuals), with its declared shape and the system that draws it, in registry order. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{ registry, name, label, description?, icon?, shape?, system … }>
  ```
- `hub/row_actions`: The actions rows of some types offer, as the run's person may use them: each type's methods, narrowed and relabelled by a widget's list, with any fn it binds to the row's columns. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    types: list<text>,
    narrow?: list<obj{
      fn: text,
      label?: text{minLength=1},
      confirm?: literal<bool>{value=true},
      bind: any,
      then?: enum<text>{open, refresh, status}
    }>
  }) => list<obj{
    fn: text,
    label: text{minLength=1},
    mode: enum<text>{read, write, delete},
    confirm: bool,
    bind: any,
    form?: typ<any>,
    then: enum<text>{open, refresh, status}
  }>
  ```
- `hub/chat`: The chat agent: answers people in a session with every tool the session allows. A fn of the `hub/llm` kind.

  ```text
  (obj) => text
  ```
- `hub/chat_small`: The chat agent for small local models: the static toolset and the graph contextor, so each prompt fits a small window. A fn of the `hub/llm` kind.

  ```text
  (obj) => text
  ```
- `hub/configure_provider`: Add a model provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama) with its API key, or replace its key. The key is stored encrypted. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ provider, apiKey?, baseURL?, contextWindow?, region?, auth?, profilePrefix? … }) => obj{models: num{whole=true}}
  ```
- `hub/set_model_category`: Add a model category (a named, ordered list of models), or change the one with this id. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{id?: text, name: text, description: text, models: list<text>}) => obj{/* modelCategory id */ id: text}
  ```
- `hub/set_budget`: Add a spending budget for the hub, a group, a user, a session, a system, a fn or a model, or change the one with this id. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ id?, target, period, maxCost, maxTokens?, maxCalls?, maxTime?, share?, onLimit … }) => obj{/* budget id */ id: text}
  ```
- `hub/set_priority`: Add a priority rule (the default and highest priority of turns at a level), or change the one with this id. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ id?, target, default?, max? … }) => obj{/* priorityRule id */ id: text}
  ```
- `hub/set_policy`: Add a policy saying whether actors may run fns (allow, deny, or ask an approver), or change the one with this id. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ id?, description, subject, target, decision, priority, expiresAt? … }) => obj{/* policy id */ id: text}
  ```
- `hub/set_actor_setting`: Set a setting a system declares for a user, group or agent. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{setting: text, /* actor id */ actor: text, value: any}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/add_user`: Add a person who can sign in, with their role and groups. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{email: text, name: text, role: enum<text>{admin, member}, groups?: list<text>}) => obj{/* actor id */ id: text}
  ```
- `hub/add_group`: Add a group of people. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{name: text, about: text, members?: list<text>}) => obj{/* actor id */ id: text}
  ```
- `hub/remove_rule`: Remove a budget, priority rule, policy, model category or provider. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    kind: or<literal<text>{value="budget"}, literal<text>{value="priority"}, literal<text>{value="policy"}, literal<text>{value="category"}, literal<text>{value="provider"}>,
    id: or<text, text, text, text, text>
  }) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/approve_pairing`: Approve or refuse a system that asked to pair with the hub, optionally naming its instance and setting its config. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    /* pairing id */ pairing: text,
    approve: bool,
    instance?: text,
    config?: any,
    autoPair?: obj{
      expiresIn?: nullable<num{whole=true, min=0}>
    }
  }) => obj{system?: text}
  ```
- `hub/create_pairing_token`: Make a one-time pairing token a new system can pair with, optionally for one system name. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    name?: text,
    expiresIn: num{whole=true, min=0},
    autoPair?: obj{
      expiresIn?: nullable<num{whole=true, min=0}>
    }
  }) => obj{token: text, expiresAt: num{whole=true}}
  ```
- `hub/configure_system`: Set a system's config; refused unless it fits the system's config type. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, config: any, instance?: text}) => or<obj{version: num{whole=true}}, obj{problems: list<text>}>
  ```
- `hub/enable_system`: Turn a system's functions, its renderers and all of its context on or off. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, functions?: bool, renderers?: bool, context?: bool}) => obj{
    enabled: obj{functions: bool, renderers: bool, context?: bool}
  }
  ```
- `hub/switch_item`: Turn one fn or context item of a system on or off. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    section: enum<text>{fns, context},
    name: text,
    on: bool
  }) => obj{on: bool}
  ```
- `hub/remove_system`: Remove a system; its fns become unavailable until it pairs again. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text}) => obj{fnsUnavailable: num{whole=true}}
  ```
- `hub/install_system`: Install a system from a folder, a package or a git repository, and start it. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    source: or<obj{path: text}, obj{package: text, version: text}, obj{git: text, ref: text}, obj{zip: text, file: text}>,
    config?: any,
    autoStart?: bool
  }) => obj{name: text}
  ```
- `hub/start_system`: Start an installed system. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, instance?: text}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/stop_system`: Stop an installed system. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, instance?: text}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/restart_system`: Restart a system instance, with the reason. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    system: text,
    instance?: text,
    reason: text{minLength=1, maxLength=200}
  }) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/upgrade_system`: Upgrade an installed system to a version (the latest when none is given). Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, version?: text}) => obj{from: text, to: text}
  ```
- `hub/set_model_role`: Choose the model (and provider) for a job: chat, transcription, dictation (or the browser's own), speech, describing images, reading text in them. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ role, engine?, language?, model?, provider? … }) => obj{ role, choice?, from, resolved? … }
  ```
- `hub/clear_model_role`: Clear a job's model choice, so it falls back to the hub's default (or is off). Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    role: enum<text>{chat, transcribe, dictate, speak, describe, ocr}
  }) => obj{ role, choice?, from, resolved? … }
  ```
- `hub/set_model_limits`: Set a model's context window, output limit, reasoning reserve or characters per token; with every field absent, clear them. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    model: text{minLength=1},
    limits: obj{
      contextWindow?: num{whole=true, min=256},
      maxOutputTokens?: num{whole=true, min=16},
      reasoningTokens?: num{whole=true, min=0},
      charsPerToken?: num{min=1, max=8}
    }
  }) => obj{ model, limits, sources, ratio … }
  ```
- `hub/create_mcp`: Make a hub MCP: an MCP endpoint with its own route and secret, exposing the systems, fns, types, context and resources its rules include. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ slug, name, instructions, rules, toolMode, user, grantees, origins, enabled … }) => obj{ mcp, secret … }
  ```
- `hub/update_mcp`: Change a hub MCP's name, rules, tool mode or person, or turn it on or off. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ slug?, name?, instructions?, rules?, toolMode?, user?, grantees?, origins?, enabled?, mcp … }) => obj{ id, slug, name, instructions, rules, toolMode, user, actor, grantees, origins, enabled, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt, url, sessions, callsToday … }
  ```
- `hub/rotate_mcp_secret`: Give a hub MCP a new secret; every open session of it ends. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* mcp id */ mcp: text}) => obj{secret: text}
  ```
- `hub/delete_mcp`: Delete a hub MCP. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* mcp id */ mcp: text}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/preview_mcp`: What draft hub MCP rules would expose now, with warnings, before they are saved. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ rules … }) => obj{
    fns: list<text>,
    types: list<text>,
    closure: list<text>,
    context: list<text>,
    resources: list<obj{uri: text, system?: text, instance?: text}>,
    reach: list<text>,
    warnings: list<text>
  }
  ```
- `hub/install_package`: Install a system package zip (made by `harness system pack`), pair it, configure it and start it. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    zip: obj{hash: text, size: num{whole=true, min=0}, mime: text},
    instance?: text,
    config?: any,
    data?: obj{hash: text, size: num{whole=true, min=0}, mime: text},
    autoStart?: bool
  }) => obj{system: text, instance: text}
  ```
- `hub/add_instance`: Add an instance of a bundled fleet system (an MCP server, an API service) with its config: installed, paired and started on the hub machine. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, instance: text, description?: text, config: any}) => obj{system: text, instance: text}
  ```
- `hub/remove_instance`: Remove one instance of a system. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, instance: text}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/suggest_decision_set`: Turn the suggestion decision model on or off, and set how many candidates it sees and picks. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{ enabled?, model?, messages?, candidates?, cap?, floor? … }) => obj{ value, setBy?, updatedAt? … }
  ```
- `hub/auto_pair_revoke`: Revoke an auto-pair secret, so its instance must pair again by code or token. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* autoPair id */ id: text}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/system_reimport`: Import a system's stored contract again, re-checking every entry. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text}) => obj{
    added: list<text>,
    updated: list<text>,
    removed: list<text>,
    refused: list<obj{name: text, problems: list<text>}>
  }
  ```
- `hub/export_system_data`: Zip an instance's data folder with its config (secret fields only when asked) and return the content. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text, instance: text, withSecrets?: bool}) => obj{hash: text, size: num{whole=true, min=0}, mime: text, url: text}
  ```
- `hub/budgets_list`: Every budget rule with what it has spent so far. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{ id, target, period, maxCost, maxTokens?, maxCalls?, maxTime?, share?, onLimit, setBy, spent … }>
  ```
- `hub/policies_list`: Every policy: who it is for, which fns, and whether they run, ask or are refused. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{ id, description, subject, target, decision, priority, expiresAt?, createdBy, createdAt … }>
  ```
- `hub/priority_rules_list`: Every priority rule: the default and highest priority of the hub, groups, people and sessions. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{ id, target, default?, max?, setBy … }>
  ```
- `hub/providers_list`: The model providers set up, with how many models each offers. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{
    /* provider id */ id: text,
    provider: enum<text>{openai, openrouter, ollama, aws},
    models: num{whole=true}
  }>
  ```
- `hub/actors_list`: People, groups, agents, systems and hub MCPs the hub knows, optionally of one kind. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    kind?: enum<text>{user, group, agent, system, mcp}
  }) => list<or<obj{
    /* actor id */ id: text,
    name: text,
    about: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    disabled: bool,
    kind: literal<text>{value="user"},
    email: text,
    role: enum<text>{admin, member},
    timeZone?: text
  }, obj{
    /* actor id */ id: text,
    name: text,
    about: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    disabled: bool,
    kind: literal<text>{value="group"}
  }, obj{
    /* actor id */ id: text,
    name: text,
    about: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    disabled: bool,
    kind: literal<text>{value="agent"},
    fn: text
  }, obj{
    /* actor id */ id: text,
    name: text,
    about: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    disabled: bool,
    kind: literal<text>{value="system"},
    system: text
  }, obj{
    /* actor id */ id: text,
    name: text,
    about: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    disabled: bool,
    kind: literal<text>{value="mcp"},
    /* mcp id */ mcp: text
  }>>
  ```
- `hub/actor_settings_list`: The settings systems declare, and the values set for people and groups. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => obj{ declared, values … }
  ```
- `hub/mcps_list`: The hub MCPs: what each exposes, for whom, and whether it is on. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{ id, slug, name, instructions, rules, toolMode, user, actor, grantees, origins, enabled, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt, url, sessions, callsToday … }>
  ```
- `hub/mcp_sessions_list`: The clients connected to one hub MCP now. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* mcp id */ mcp: text}) => list<obj{
    /* mcp id */ mcp: text,
    session: text,
    label: text,
    client?: obj{name: text, version: text},
    since: num{whole=true},
    lastCallAt?: num{whole=true},
    calls: num{whole=true, min=0}
  }>
  ```
- `hub/pairings_list`: Pairing requests, newest first, optionally of one status. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    status?: enum<text>{pending, approved, rejected, expired}
  }) => list<obj{ id, name, keyFingerprint, publicKey, version, address, method, code?, replaces?, description?, instance?, configType?, configSecrets?, status, createdAt, expiresAt … }>
  ```
- `hub/auto_pairs_list`: The auto-pair secrets granted, optionally for one system. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{system?: text}) => list<obj{
    /* autoPair id */ id: text,
    system: text,
    instance: text,
    /* actor id */ createdBy: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true},
    expiresAt?: num{whole=true},
    lastUsedAt?: num{whole=true},
    uses: num{whole=true, min=0},
    revokedAt?: num{whole=true}
  }>
  ```
- `hub/instances_list`: One system's instances, with their status, version, config (secrets masked) and host. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text}) => list<obj{ system, instance, description, status, keyFingerprint, version, manifestHash, config?, installed?, host?, dirs?, pairedAt?, pairedBy?, lastSeenAt?, address?, connect? … }>
  ```
- `hub/suggest_decision_get`: The suggestion decision model setting: whether a model picks the suggestions, and its limits. Tags: `admin`, `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => obj{ value, setBy?, updatedAt? … }
  ```

Fns for this: fn:fs/read, fn:fs/write, fn:fs/edit, fn:fs/bash.
